chapters.title: The Basement
paragraphs: Burgundy had been awake for thirty-one hours, soldering the device that would change Dross forever. Tomorrow he would carry it down to the South Twelfth Shaft, where the delvers coughed black and the royals grew fat.
He pressed his thumb against the warm casing and whispered Aldric's name. The monitors flickered green in the dark, and somewhere below the palace the night shift rang its bell.

chapters.title: The Court
paragraphs: Nicholas the shadow buyer arrived unannounced, slipping past the steward into the throne room as if doors had never applied to him.

He wanted the device. Burgundy refused. Nicholas said nothing, set a single gold coin on the table, and walked out. The coin lay where he left it, stamped with a two-headed crane, the mark of no mint Burgundy had ever seen.

chapters.title: The Collapse
paragraphs: The shaft collapsed at dawn. Smoke rose over the amber horizon like a second sunrise, and the bells this time did not stop.
Burgundy ran toward it, the device clutched to his chest, past every point of return he had ever drawn for himself.
